description: Keep related repositories, shared context and chats in one space. Use ai-workspace for shared files, notes and groups, and Repowise for code queries across repositories. Install or update both optional CLIs per device from settings; downloads use GitHub and PyPI and can include uv and Python. Organize common and project threads, manage compact AGENTS.md blocks, and track pending input in the sidebar. Requires BB 0.49+; the interface is Russian, and chats use your configured agent account or quota.
